summary: Added sdk/fleet/orchestrator.py: AccountContext, FleetOrchestrator (sequential, alias order, dry-run default, per-account runner with the account's own alias, foreign-snapshot and shared-journal refusal before any call, per-account error containment with redacted reasons, fleet stop file, max_actions), spent_in_period and budgeted_policy_config (reserves raised to balance minus remaining budget; starbux spend never allowed), FleetRun/AccountRun records. Fixed AccountProfile so an omitted starbux budget is 0, with a regression test that fails on the previous registry. 11 orchestrator tests plus the registry regression test. Orchestration documented in docs/baseline/fleet-accounts.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Accounts ran one per process with no isolation checks or budgets, and an omitted starbux budget meant unlimited
contract_status_changes.after: Accounts run sequentially with enforced isolation, contained failures, a fleet stop, budget-bounded plans and no starbux spend
proof: tests.test_fleet_accounts: 9 tests OK; the starbux regression test fails on the previous registry

residual_risks: Budget enforcement relies on journaled cost deltas; spend made outside the journal (manual play) is not counted.
The orchestrator is not wired into run.py; that is part of the blocked live fleet trial.
